_readme: THE ORDERING CATEGORIES — what a customer sees before they see any food.
Nine of them, on purpose. Usability research puts the overwhelm point at about
ten choices: past that, people stop reading and start scrolling aimlessly.
150 items in one list is a movie catalogue, and nobody picks a film quickly.
Each category pulls its items from one or more GROUP IDs in menu.json, so
prices only ever live in one place. Order here is the order on screen.
TO REORDER: move the block up or down.
TO MOVE items between categories: change which group ids are listed.
TO ADD a category: copy a block, give it a new id, list its groups, pick a photo.
'blurb' shows under the category name once it is open.
